summary: Offline backtest-prep package 'futbt' built under code/ (12 modules + 10 test files, stdlib-only) covering: (1) per-contract raw adapter for the IBKR JSON format incl. filename markers front/next/nearest_expired, close-only settlement-bar detection, BID/ASK v=-1 semantics, error-162-empty tolerance, and a 10-symbol instrument/definition table (6J USD-per-JPY with orientation guard, SI 5000oz, multipliers/minTicks from IBKR secdef S1) plus an exchange calendar/DST placeholder interface that hard-stops NOT_RUN; (2) roll engine with the declared PIT baseline (last session before day-1 of expiry month by last-trade date), a strictly-earlier-cutoff PIT VolumeRollRule (final same-day volume/OI refused), full roll tables (old/new, reason, volumes, OI=NOT_RUN, raw gap, additive+ratio factors), raw execution chains and causal additive feature-only adjustment (ratio refused on non-positive prices); (3) accounting kernel with negative-CL arithmetic PnL, log-return tripwire, Decimal tick rounding, 6J plausibility band, cash ledger reconciliation, margin interface over published broker tables; (4) cost model with PUBLISHED/MEASURED/DECLARED/NOT_RUN per component, completeness refusal, explicit nonzero declared-slippage hook, x1/1.5/2 stress, sampled-BBO caveat; (5) journal with PIT feature snapshots, trigger/veto, fills/rolls/exits, MAE/MFE, censoring, frozen breakeven tolerance, AMBIGUOUS_ORDER bounded scenarios with no point PnL; (6) deterministic replay engine with PIT-enforced data view, next-open fills, intrabar TP/SL, same-bar TP+SL ambiguity, auto-roll with rebased stops, forced exit at the expiry wall, close-only bars never fill, per-session cash reconciliation, truncation and future-mutation test hooks; (7) walk-forward scaffolding (exposure calendar, purge>=true-horizon enforcement, embargo audit trail, performance-reason fold suppression forbidden, nested TRAIN selection stamped at train_end); (8) composition scaffolding (sleeve descriptives incl. co-loss, risk caps with audit trail, DECLARED-weights combine with IN_SAMPLE_MASQUERADE guard, leave-one-leg/one-rule via full-path re-runs, additive leg-PnL attribution forbidden, flat/always-on/single-leg baselines). All 140 tests run offline on deterministic synthetic fixtures and pass. Adapter smoke on the real read-only raw snapshot parses 1160/1160 files (OBSERVED, descriptive only, no PnL). Launch DRAFT written with arms/variants/trial formula/seeds/calendar/cost assumptions/PIT rules/admission+pass bars, explicitly pending data-depth decision + registration.
findings: OBSERVED (adapter smoke, script code/scripts/smoke_adapter_real.py, window: full raw snapshot 2026-10-02, 1160 files): all 1160 filenames parse against the pattern {SYM}_{LOCAL}_{CONID}[_(front|next|nearest_expired)]_{TRADES|BID|ASK}_{1day|1hour|1min}_{SPAN}.json; the snapshot contains not only _front_ but also _next_ and _nearest_expired_ marker files (data-lane docs only mentioned _front_), and 179 files carry IBKR error 162 'HMDS query returned no data' with zero bars (tolerated class; all other error classes fail the load).

OBSERVED (same smoke): 202 (symbol,conid) contracts grouped; close-only settlement-bar fractions per symbol: 6A .879, 6B .865, 6E .828, 6J .867, CL .761, ES .815, GC .725, NG .648, NQ .764, SI .714 — reproduces the data lane's 25-90% pathology and re-confirms deep bars are reference-only prices.

OBSERVED (synthetic fixture + tests): the declared calendar roll baseline is exactly recoverable — roll engine matches known-truth decision sessions, old/new conids and raw gaps for all fixture symbols; the PIT volume rule rolls materially earlier (fixture: 2024-09-04 vs 2024-09-30 for the first CL roll), demonstrating the two roll variants are genuinely distinguishable for framework test #11.

POSTULATED + enforced in code: causal additive (panama) adjustment subtracts the cumulative past-gap from post-roll segments; adding it instead would double the roll jump (bug caught and fixed during development; regression test test_additive_adjustment_removes_roll_jump pins continuity across rolls).

Cost completeness reality: with slippage undeclared (repo has NO declared futures slippage value) and exchange fees unfetched for 9/10 symbols, only ES has a complete published commission stack (0.85+1.38+0.01=2.24, reproduced in tests); the cost book refuses complete totals while components are NOT_RUN instead of fabricating zeros.

Engine semantics frozen: same-bar TP+SL produces AMBIGUOUS_ORDER records with tp_first/sl_first bounds, point PnL None, and a deterministic worst-case ledger booking; close-only bars cannot fill (orders lapse with reason); open positions auto-roll at the baseline date with stops rebased by the raw gap, and force-exit when no next-contract price exists on the roll date (first-notice/expiry wall).

Walk-forward guards verified by tests: purge < true horizon raises; fold drops for performance reasons raise PolicyError (only INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE legal); nested selection is stamped at train_end; replay is deterministic and prefix-determinism/future-mutation hooks pass.

NOT_RUN (placeholder by design, do not fake): real exchange holiday/DST calendar; delivery-month expiry basis; open interest (absent from raw IBKR bars); per-symbol exchange fees (9/10); declared slippage; CME SPAN margins; overnight position fees; capacity/intrabar-path proof from daily BBO.
defects: No open defects in delivered code. Fixed during development (all pinned by tests): calendar next/prev inclusive off-by-one; causal adjustment sign (was doubling the roll jump); cost fill-adjustment summing the side flag into the total; intraday duplicate-date dedup (dedup key must be the full bar timestamp); JournalRecord requiring exit fields at construction; TP_SL_SAME_BAR missing from journal EXIT_TYPES.
open_questions: Owner data-depth decision (vendor purchase vs prospective accumulation vs accepting the ~14-month true-volume window) — gates Arm B of the launch draft.
Owner-declared nonzero slippage values per symbol (proposed default for discussion: 1 tick/side) and per-symbol exchange fee fetch — required before any complete-cost pass bar.

Expiry-month basis confirmation: engine default uses the month of the raw expiry_month field (= last-trade date). If the intended basis is the DELIVERY month for NYMEX energy/metals, an exchange-published mapping table is needed (currently NOT_RUN).
Real exchange holiday calendar source (CME transport-blocked 2026-10-02): until supplied, launches would run on the empirical bar-union calendar with a stamped caveat.
Exact rule set R (from the dossiers lane) needed to freeze the launch trial counts (formula: 180*R*K primary cells + 13 baselines + 10+R ablations).

test_run_evidence.result: Ran 140 tests in ~1.8s — OK (run twice, identical result; fully offline on deterministic synthetic fixtures; no network, no raw-data writes, no lock)
